scripts.title: Auto Fishing
scripts.features:
--> Features:
  --> Auto-Fishing: The script will automatically fish for you *IF YOU HAVE THE WOODEN ROD*. (As stated above, if people are interested I will update it to diversity)
  --> Auto-Eating: While fishing, if your hunger drops below 99, the player will quickly munch on one of these items in your inventory: Red Apple, Coconut, Grapes, White mushroom, Brown mushroom.
  --> Hidden: To lower the risk, you're hidden from other players.
  --> Don't-Disturb: Your player is constantly locked in a position, making it difficult for the user to accidentally stop the farm.
--> Requirements:
  --> As mentioned above, those are the only allowed items to be ate for now. (It's really more of a soft-requirement, since you can still fish without them, but you'll die of starvation in some time)
  --> Shift-locking may tamper with the auto farm, so if you alt tabbed from the game, it's possible your farm may have stopped (can be fixed in future updates)
  --> Wooden Rod.
  --> Recommended to be on server under 200 ping, as this ping 100% will break the farm, and not even start (can be fixed in future updates easily)

scripts.title: fling vehicles and annoy people
scripts.features:
you need to execute in infinite yield (included in script) these commands: "flyfling", "nosit"  and "freecam" first, then press the button
(this game don't have minimum account age limit for now, so you can just create new accounts to avoid gamebans)
scripts.script:
warn("🚨in infinite yield, execute flyfling, nosit and freecam to make this work properly")
loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EdgeIY/infiniteyield/master/source'))()
local players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = players.LocalPlayer
local rootPart = player.Character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local tpInterval = 0.000001

local function tp()
    while true do
        local randomPlayer = players:GetPlayers()[math.random(1, #players:GetPlayers())]
        if randomPlayer ~= player and randomPlayer.Character and randomPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local targetPosition = randomPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
            rootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(targetPosition)
        end
        wait(tpInterval)
    end
end

local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
local runButton = Instance.new("TextButton")

screenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

runButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 50)
runButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -50, 0.5, -25)
runButton.Text = "Start TPing"
runButton.Parent = screenGui

runButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    screenGui:Destroy()
    tp()
end)
